dev.text: Konta is still being built. This site describes the product we are making and how far along it is. You can’t buy it yet.
easy.p1: In Konta an invoice looks like an invoice. You can see straight away what needs filling in, and whatever is calculated for you stays out of the way.
easy.p2: The interface is complete in both Romanian and Russian. The number keys you use in 1C stay the same, so years of habit carry over. The terms come from the national accounting standards and the Tax Code, the way you say them every day.
easy.p3: When something goes wrong, a person answers the phone, in Romanian or Russian.
easy.title: Easy to use from day one
ef.caveat: Every rule here is in our public register, with a reference to the legal act. A licensed accountant is still checking the values.
ef.law.p1: Today e-Factura is mandatory in three cases: supplies to state institutions, supplies to agents with no fiscal relationship with the budget (since 1 January 2025), and companies that SFS has put on its risk list.
ef.law.p2: International VAT trackers report that e-Factura becomes mandatory for every company on 1 October 2026. We haven’t yet found a Moldovan legal act that sets this date. When one appears, we’ll add it to the register and say so here.
ef.law.p3: From 1 January 2026 the rule that denied a buyer the VAT deduction on a paper invoice from a listed supplier was repealed.
ef.law.p4: Several sources say the VAT refund ceiling rises to 70% for businesses that use e-Factura or MEV. It isn’t in the Ministry of Finance summary of the 2026 changes, so we’re checking it before relying on it.
ef.law.title: What the law says today

np.meta.title: Accounting without a programmer · Konta
np.p1: In a program where tax rules live in the code, every new law means paying a programmer to come and rewrite it, separately on each installation. Konta keeps the law as data. We change it once and every customer has it the same day.
np.p2: The 2027 tax reform has passed its first reading. This is what it changes:
np.p3: In an ordinary program, each row of this table is another call to the programmer. In Konta these changes appear in the register on their own, the same day, and anyone can check them. You don’t pay extra for them.
np.title: Why you won’t need a programmer any more
open.b1: Anyone can read which rate we apply, from which date and under which law. If a figure is wrong, it shows from the outside.
open.b2: The code that talks to SFS on your behalf can be read by anyone, line by line.
open.b3: You’ll be able to export all your data in open formats whenever you like, without asking and without paying. Leaving us should be as easy as joining.
open.b4: This site has no analytics or tracking tools. Your browser sends no request anywhere except konta.md, not even for fonts.
open.h3: Your data leaves with you, any time
